scenes: Across Indonesia’s islands, the heat is humid, all year round.
In 2024, Indonesia’s weather stations ran point eight of a degree above the 1991 to 2020 average.
A health climate action plan, adopted by ministerial decree in 2025, | and a national cooling plan that combines passive design, efficiency and cleaner refrigerants.
By 2040, half of Southeast Asia’s air conditioners could be in Indonesia, | which is why cooler buildings matter so much.
Cool by design, and by efficient machines.
